entities.name: Thorleif Schjelderup-Ebbe
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Thorleif Schjelderup-Ebbe was a Norwegian zoologist and comparative psychologist. He was the first person to describe a pecking order of hens, a discovery that contributed to understanding dominance hierarchies across species and influenced the field of ethology.
